注 1：28~30 句常用于自荐、推荐、求职，任选 2 句背下来；31~33 句常用于
提出要求，例如招聘、招募志愿者、找队友，任选 2 句背下来。
注 2：对于一个人来说需要具备的能力——
Self-motivation 内 驱 力 /Initiative 主 动 性 / Drive and Ambition 干 劲 与 雄 心
Resilience 韧性/ Perseverance 毅力/Reliability 可靠性/ Diligence 勤奋/ Sense of
Responsibility 责任感/ Accountability 担当精神/ Integrity 诚信/ Professionalism
职业精神/ Positive Attitude 积极态度/ Open-mindedness 开放心态/ Curiosity 好奇
心/ Enthusiasm 热情/ Critical Thinking 批判性思维/ Problem-solving 解决问题/
Logical Reasoning 逻辑推理/ Creativity 创造力/ Communication Skills 沟通能力/
Teamwork 团队合作/ Collaboration 协作精神/ Interpersonal Skills 人际交往能力/
Leadership 领导力/ Execution 执行力/ Efficiency 效

率/ Adaptability 适应性/ Time
Management 时间管理/ Stress Management 抗压能力等。
                                     感谢和道歉
34. I am extremely grateful to you for your unselfish assistance/ advice during the
    period of ...
     我非常感谢您在…期间（学习/工作）给我的无私帮助/建议。
35. It is your hospitality/ enthusiasm/ assistance that enabled me to ...
     正是你的款待/热情/帮助使我能够…（参考五大方面）
36. Without your generous help, I would not have made such great progress in...
     如果没有你的慷概帮助，我就不会在某方面取得重大进步。
37. Without your generous help, I would not have such a wonderful experience.
     如果没有你慷概帮助，我就不会有如此美妙的经历。
38. All of us desire to improve the ability of               under your professional
    guidance.
    我们期望在您的指导下提升某能力。
注：34~38 句就是拍马屁，不管感谢还是道歉，都能

拍。邀请信也能拍（38 句）。
39. To make up for it, I am ready to immediately correct the mistake / offer my full
    assistance to resolve the matter.
     为了弥补，我准备立即纠正错误/全力协助解决此事。
